summary: User withdrew $85 worth of ETH from Bovada to an Ethereum address that they did not recognize instead of their intended Trust Wallet address. The source does not establish how the incorrect address was selected and the suggestion of address poisoning in the comments is unconfirmed.
prevention: Verify the complete destination address before confirming every withdrawal / Use a trusted saved address and send a small test transaction first
classification_warning: possible address poisoning but insufficient evidence to confirm attacker involvement
